name: tert-butylaminoethanol
description: Tert-butylaminoethanol (CAS 4620-70-6 ) is a bifunctional amino alcohol combining both amine and hydroxyl reactivity in a single molecule. It functions as a pH regulator, corrosion inhibitor, and reactive intermediate across industrial and specialty chemical formulations. In water treatment and metalworking fluids, it provides corrosion inhibition by neutralizing acidic species and forming protective complexes on metal surfaces. This dual functionality makes it a versatile component for complex chemical systems. Coatings and adhesive formulators use it as a neutralizing amine to adjust pH in waterborne resin systems, improving stability and film formation. This ensures that the final product maintains its integrity and performance over time. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into emulsion systems where controlled alkalinity and compatibility with surfactant blends are required. Its unique structure allows for precise control over the chemical environment of the formulation. In lubricant formulations, it acts as a functional additive that combines buffering capacity with surface-active behavior to extend fluid service life. This helps in maintaining the efficiency of machinery and reducing maintenance costs. Tert-butylaminoethanol is supplied as a clear liquid in standard drum and IBC packaging suited to industrial procurement volumes. This ensures that large-scale operations can maintain a steady supply of this essential chemical intermediate. Technical grade is the primary commercial offering, with purity specifications typically at 99% or above. High purity levels are critical for ensuring consistent results in demanding industrial and specialty chemical applications. Buyers should confirm concentration and moisture content specifications with suppliers when sourcing for sensitive formulation applications.
